page.notes: Whole body text is set in italic type; I have marked it as such. Words broken at line ends: "ro-bur" and "spera-veram" (the second word's exact letters after "spera-" are the least certain reading; the printed line-end hyphen is kept). "fi-" at the foot of the last line continues as the catchword "lio". Long s is printed as f in several places and has been rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "refistere", "senilem", "suis").
